product_updates.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
product_updates.content: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

product_updates.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
product_updates.content: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

product_updates.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
product_updates.content: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

product_updates.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
product_updates.content: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

product_updates.title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
product_updates.content: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.

product_updates.title: HackerRank’s AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become
product_updates.content: HackerRank’s AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among its early testers.

product_updates.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
product_updates.content: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.

product_updates.content: Independent researchers discovered an agent swarm that seems to be running on Tencent's infrastructure and targeting Alibaba's map service, Amap.
